faq.question1: What file formats does iLoveMarkdown support?
faq.answer1: iLoveMarkdown supports bidirectional conversion between PDF, Word, and Markdown, including PDF→MD, Word→MD, MD→PDF, MD→Word.
faq.question2: What are the limitations of the free version?
faq.answer2: The free version supports single file conversion (≤10MB), with a daily conversion limit of 10 times, providing basic conversion features.
faq.answer3: We attach great importance to user privacy, uploaded files will be automatically deleted within 72 hours, and we will not store user privacy data.
faq.question4: What are the advantages of the Pro version?
faq.answer4: The Pro version provides unlimited conversions, batch processing, large file support (≤50MB), ad-free, priority conversion, format optimization and other advanced features.
